$schema_note: SKU -> real product-BOX packshot manifest for the Kodiak composed-preview pipeline. This is the SOURCE data that lets compose show the actual retail box instead of a generated white-bread/candy stand-in.

contract.shape: top-level 'map' dict keyed by sku-id (product handle), same key space as sku-photo-map.json so the pipeline can EXTEND rather than replace
contract.relationship_to_sku_photo_map: sku-photo-map.json maps sku-id -> LIFESTYLE/recipe photo (photo_key) used as a generation seed. THIS file adds packshot_key = the real product BOX to composite verbatim, plus lifestyle_keys[] = real recipe/lifestyle shots usable as compose backgrounds. Merge strategy: for each sku-id, pipeline reads packshot_key from here for the foreground box layer; keeps photo_key from sku-photo-map.json for the background/seed layer.

per_entry_fields.sku_id: product handle (matches sku-photo-map.json key and kodiak-full-catalog.json handle)
per_entry_fields.packshot_key: full S3 key of the best real product-box packshot, or null if no real box found
per_entry_fields.packshot_confidence: high = exact UPC-prefixed box file confirmed present in DAM; medium = real box present but a variant/near-match; low = approximated; null = no real box
per_entry_fields.lifestyle_keys: 2-3 real recipe/lifestyle S3 keys usable as compose background candidates
per_entry_fields.caption: short display caption

provenance.ground_truth: packshot_key values verified against the raw-ingest images directory (local mirror of the DAM prefix) file listing; only filenames confirmed present are cited. catalog fields (upc, display_name, category, cdn image filenames) from data/products/kodiak-full-catalog.json. lifestyle_keys drawn from data/products/sku-photo-map.json photo_key/fallbacks (already verified matched=true).
provenance.verification_note: packshot filenames are the same 705599* UPC-prefixed names the kodiakcakes.com Shopify CDN serves; the DAM raw-ingest sync stored them verbatim under packshot_prefix. Every high-confidence key below was matched character-for-character against the DAM listing.
provenance.coverage: top 40 SKUs prioritized (all baking-mixes, all bars, all cups, flagship flapjack/waffle mixes + power cakes/waffles + oatmeal + granola). Remaining long-tail SKUs (frozen sandwiches, gift cards, overnight-oats pouches, some oatmeal-packets) are out of this pass and flagged in unmapped[].
